fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on alleged police brutality in Miami (including the case of Charles Haynes, who shot Detective Beckham), criticism of city officials for inaction, and discussion of Prohibition-era enforcement and a Chicago Daily Tribune editorial on coast guardsmen acquitted in a killing. Other items include Miami Beach policing and misconduct, a call to support Miami’s Community Chest, advocacy for a downtown public library, notes on juvenile performers and child labor law loopholes, announcements about a planned marine pageant tied to the Mid-Winter Regatta (March 15) and other local civic news. The issue also contains society/arrival notes, sports coverage (boxing bouts), and extensive local advertising including the Eighth Annual Automobile Show at Cinderella Ballroom.
